notes: Answers: the purpose is one or two sentences (a second line goes on the form's second line). Addresses are split onto the form's two lines: street, then city, MD ZIP. The return address is three lines, 'name; street; city, ST ZIP'. The signatures of the authorized person (item 5) and of the resident agent (item 6) are left for them: SDAT asks for an originally executed document. The $100 fee goes with it by check, or the same filing is made online in Maryland Business Express.

lines.en: Name of the limited liability company (with LLC, L.L.C., L.C. or Limited Liability Company)
lines.zh: 有限责任公司名称（须含 LLC、L.L.C.、L.C. 或 Limited Liability Company）

lines.en: Purpose of the LLC: a one or two sentence description of the business
lines.zh: LLC 的经营目的：一两句话描述业务

lines.en: Address of the LLC in Maryland (no P.O. box): street, city, MD ZIP
lines.zh: LLC 在马里兰州的地址（不可为邮政信箱）：街道、城市、MD 邮编

lines.en: Resident agent's name (a Maryland resident over 18, or a Maryland corporation or LLC); the agent signs too
lines.zh: 常驻代理人姓名（年满 18 岁的马里兰州居民，或马里兰州公司或 LLC）；代理人也须签字

lines.en: Resident agent's address (no P.O. box): street, city, MD ZIP
lines.zh: 常驻代理人地址（不可为邮政信箱）：街道、城市、MD 邮编

lines.en: Filing party's return address: 'name; street; city, ST ZIP'
lines.zh: 提交人回寄地址：“姓名；街道；城市、州、邮编”
